contexts.text: The simple in heart say they know there is a spirit, because the Lord has said that they shall live after death. These do not extinguish their Rational, but make it live by the Word of the Lord.
Be ye... simple as doves. AC 3900:5.
The doctrine called Cain, when in its simplicity, not so ungrateful.

He who believes simply, or from a simple heart, does not first assume principles; but thinks that it is true because the Lord has said so; and, if instructed from other sayings of the Word, he acquiesces, and rejoices. Even he who believes from simplicity that the Lord is angry, etc., and so is afraid of evil and does good, does himself no harm. Explained. AC 735. AC 1408:3. AC 1798:4. AC 2395:2.
Very many in falsities are yet saved... gentiles, and also Christians, who have believed from simplicity of heart. The very ignorance and simplicity excuse, because in these there may be innocence.
The simple in heart can be instructed from the appearances with man; for they scarcely go beyond Knowledges from sensuous things, and therefore the Word speaks according to their apprehension.
He who is considered in Heaven from externals, is [so considered] because he has simplicity, and in simplicity innocence and charity...
When man believes the Word simply, and has charity, although he remains in appearances, this cloud is comparatively thin. Explained.
This parent Church (Noah) did this not from malice, but from simplicity.
The Lord is much more present with infants than adults, (and) so with the simple who have innocence, charity, and mercy.

Many who in the world from simplicity and ignorance have imbued falsities... and have not lived in hatred, revenge, and adultery... are kept for a time in the Lower Earth, that they may there put off their principles of falsity.
Under Japheth, see this reference.
Islands = gentiles who have lived in simplicity, etc.
If the worst of the diabolical crew were present with the simple in heart, they could effect nothing, but are subjugated. Signified.

When the Word is read... by a man who from a simple heart believes what is written, and has not formed principles contrary to the truth of faith in the internal sense, it is presented by the Lord before the Angels in such beauty...
The true members of the Church are regarded as simple...
There is nothing, however simple it appears, which is not composite.
Intellectual truth is first manifest when man believes from a simple heart that it is true because so said by the Lord.
They who believe this simply have no need to know how it was done.
They who believe the Word simply have no need to know all these things, because they are in the end.
That it was so thought from innocence and simple good. Signified, Explained.
Rectitude in the Hebrew is expressed by a word which means also integrity and perfection, likewise simplicity.
From innocence (good) becomes simple good.
Composite things cannot enter into simple ones; thus not those of the body into those of the spirit; but the reverse.
Among Gentiles, as among Christians, there are wise and simple. HH 322.
At this day most Gentiles are simple in heart. HH 324.
Some... of simple faith appear to themselves in white and shining garments...
A volume rose up... They were rustics and other simple ones... They had lived in conjugial love simply.
Preface [2]. Peter was a very simple man.
These things revealed in the internal sense... are in some degree intelligible to a man who lives in simple good.
Midian = those in the truth of simple good, and thus allow themselves to be easily persuaded.
Ishmael = good, and therefore as to doctrine are in natural truth.
Earrings of gold = the things which are of simple good.
The inhabitants of the land of Tema = those in simple good, such as the upright gentiles are in.
Kedar = those in simple truth.
The isles of Chittim = the gentiles who are in simple good, and thence in natural truth.
After (temptations) man becomes mild, humble, simple...
Edom = those in simple good, which is such good as is with those who constitute the Lord's External Church. In like manner Moab, and the sons of Ammon.
When yet the simple, who are in good, and whom they despise, can perceive in a moment... that the thing is, and its quality.

One in simple good, who believes the Word simply, according to its literal sense, is gifted with the faculty of perceiving truths when instructed (there); and in the mean time the few truths he has are vivified by charity and innocence; and (then) the falsities which have infused themselves... are not hurtful. Explained.
Of the learned much fewer (believe there is a Heaven) than of the simple.
However much natural good and truth may appear to man as one simple thing...
The learned know less about these things than the simple.
Those in such simple zeal are subject to the greatest infestations by the cunning.
Those in external truths and at the same time in simple good, in the other life receive internal truths, and thence wisdom; for from simple good they are in the state and faculty for receiving them.
For there are few in affections of spiritual and celestial love, and those few are mostly simple persons, who cannot reflect upon their affections.
By which the simple suffer themselves to be seduced.
(The Word in the letter adapted to the simple.) AC 6839. DSS 40. DSS 51.
Such good (as is not genuine) is wont to be with the simple within the Church, who know few truths, but live in charity... Through such good, genuine truths and goods can be introduced...
It is not of such great importance for the simple to know (these distinctions), provided they live in charity; for charity is the life of faith.
The good in man appears to him as something simple... but is so multiple...

If (the evil) enter Heaven in any way... they are admitted only to the first entrance, that is, to those who are still simple... but they can stay scarcely any moments, because the life of love to the Lord and towards the neighbour is there.
Calling the counsels of the upright simple and bad.
The First Heaven is celestial and spiritual natural, because in simple good, which is the ultimate of order there. In like manner with a regenerated man, who is a little Heaven.
Yet those in simple good from simple faith are in the faculty of knowing the things (of angelic wisdom)...
Thus, on account of the discordance and dissuasion of the natural man, it is better to be in simple good, although in the denial of truth. Signified.
Spirits (of the ears) are those in simple obedience; that is, those who do not reason as to whether it is so, but, because it is said to be so by others, believe that it is so.
Thus they had been in simple obedience. Explained.
Every Church, at first, knows nothing but the generals of doctrine; for it is then in its simplicity.
Let this - that the blood of the Lamb signifies the Lord's passion - be for the simple, who cannot apprehend interior arcana.
Under Ishmaelite, see this reference. AC 4752. AC 4758. AC 4788:2.

Those in simple good acknowledge that the Lord's Human is Divine, and that works of charity are to be done for man to be saved. Those in faith separated know this, and therefore insist on this faith... scarcely at all before those in simple good... for if they denied such things those in simple good would say they were fools; for they know what love is and works of love; but not what faith separated from these is. Argumentations in favour of faith against works, and about the distinction between the Human and the Divine of the Lord, they would call sophisms; and therefore they willingly concede that [these truths] and what is from them, should be accepted. Signified.
Under Midianite, see this reference. AC 4788.
It is known that the learned believe in the life after death less than the simple; and that, in general, they see Divine truths less than the simple. Explained.
Hence it was that the simple believed in the Lord; but not the scribes and Pharisees.
Babes = the simple.
(Thus) the sense of the letter is of service to the simple for initiation into the internal sense.
For those in the truth of simple good mostly suffer themselves to be led away by the fallacies of the senses, thus by the scientifics which are from them. Signified.

This (conjunction with internal truth as with a harlot) is not with those who indeed believe simply the literal sense, yet live according to the things of the internal sense, namely, in love and charity, and thence in faith.
They can make others weep, and can also strike fear, (from) having been with the sick and simple, for the sake of obtaining wealth...

(A deceitful man) was admitted into a Society where are the simple good, who are in front above the head... and the good there, who were simple, began to lament that he was taking from them the perception of good and truth...
A fallacy of sense that there are simple substances, which are monads and atoms.
This is why the learned believe less than the simple, and in heavenly things are less wise; for the simple can view a Thing above terms and scientifics, thus above sensuous things...
Saying at heart that these truths are for the simple.
Those who... from ignorance or simplicity, attribute truth and good to themselves, are not condemned; but are freed by a method of vastation.
Not so those who do this not from ignorance and simplicity... but still, as they do what is good, the Lord... reserves with them something of ignorance and simplicity.
For the simple... believe that they will live after death, in which simple faith, unknown to them, is latent [the idea] that they will live there as men...
The simple and infants ought to believe (that God rewards the good, and punishes the evil). Explained.
This (arcanum) is among the things best known even to simple Spirits.
When these (learned) are promoted to honours, they live more sensuously than the simple; and then believe it to be of simplicity to attribute anything to the Divine.
They call those in a different state simple.
One idea might be filled with innumerable things, yet appear simple.
The progression of truth Divine with man... which is [one] of separation from falsities, and of adjunction with the truths of simple good. Treated of.
Under Midian, see this reference. AC 6775. AC 6827. AC 7019.
Those in the truths of simple good care for no sense but the literal.
These are they who set themselves in opposition to the doctrine of charity, consequently to those who are in the truth of simple good. Signified.
After those in the truth of simple good had undergone temptations. Signified, Explained.

They were kept in external bonds... and then simple good Spirits were adjoined to them; as is also done with men in the world, who, although interiorly devils, are kept in external bonds... and, in order (to this) Spirits who are in simple good are adjoined to them... Evil Spirits, who are in like love... lead them, and to these are adjoined simple good Spirits.

After the Lord's advent... those simple good Spirits were adjoined to those who are of the Spiritual Church (in Heaven; and thus) were enriched with the truths and goods previously possessed by the evil Genii and Spirits.
A most general truth for the simple.
What is continuous of life in simple good. Signified.
The good of the Church which is in the truth of simple good [is the] good [which] is meant by simple good.
Those who most nearly receive and communicate (the infestation) are simple upright Spirits, who serve especially for such a use. Signified, Explained.

The names (poor, etc.) are in the Word... that the simple may understand and do the Word simply, and the wise wisely; and also that by the externals of charity the simple may be initiated into its internals.
Internals are relatively purer and simple.
(They are permitted to falsify truths) lest they should seduce the simple upright Spirits with whom they have communication through truths.

That all who harass those simple ones are cast into Hell. Signified. Those of the Spiritual Church are here called those simple ones; for the evil call all those simple who are of the Church and live according to its truths and goods.
Children = simplicities.
They call those simple who do not attribute all things to self or nature.
They said that it is more simple to say (that they can do good of themselves); and the Lord leaves it to those to say so who live in simplicity and innocence.
Their external worship communicated with angelic Spirits who are simple and do not reflect on internals... Such correspond to the cuticles.
Every simple person has such an idea about intercession and mediation from the sense of the letter.
The sense of the letter is according to the apprehension of simple men, so that they may be introduced into interior truths. Explained.
By externals (hypocrites) would communicate with Heaven, namely, with those in the circuits, and are simple, who correspond to the cuticles...
Under Sheep, see this reference.
The literal sense is for the simple, etc.
Being an apparent truth, it must not be... extinguished; for so would be extinguished the faith in the Word which [exists] with the simple.
However much they may call those simple who are in good of life from truths of doctrine... the simplicity of these is wisdom before the Angels.
Let the simple remain in their doctrine that they are saved by the blood of the Lord, provided they live according to His Divine truth...
(The Spirits of the First Earth) are modest, somewhat simple...
All the wise at heart see this appearance, but not so the simple; but still the gifts and presents of the latter are grateful, in so far as they are made from ignorance in which is innocence.
To deprive of their spiritual truths those who live in simple good. Signified.
The simple apprehend this; but not the wise of the world.

The internal is closed with more of the intelligent than of the simple, because the intelligent... are more in the loves of self and the world than the simple; and are also in the faculty of confirming evils and falsities... by the scientifics in which they are more than the simple.
This interior perception has perished in the Christian world, and remains only with the simple who are in faith.
Lest this Negative should infect and corrupt also the simple in heart and the simple in faith, it has been granted me to be together with the Angels... HH 312:4.

In love there is every faculty of receiving the truths which agree with itself; (thus) those who had been simple in the world come into angelic wisdom and happiness when they come among the Angels. Explained.
(The best of the Angels live outside the Societies, but are ordinated in the same way) the wiser being in the middle, and the more simple in the boundaries.
The simple in faith and heart... have the idea that Angels are the men of Heaven, because they have not extinguished by erudition their implanted [perception] which is from Heaven...
The simple see God in thought as the Ancient One, in brightness.

Those they call simple know all these things in their way. They have an idea of their God that He is the Divine in a human form; of an Angel that he is a heavenly man; of their own soul which will live after death that it is like an Angel; and of the life of Heaven with man that it is to live according to the Divine commandments. These, therefore, the Angels call intelligent, and fitted for Heaven.
Such (spiritual) ignorance reigns more with the intelligent within the Church than with those whom they call the simple.
The speech of the simple (in Heaven) is still more exterior. Explained.
Certain simple ones, when taken up into Heaven, have come into angelic wisdom. Described.
(Those in a state of innocence) for the most part appear simple in the external form, but are wise and prudent in the internal. These are meant by: Be ye prudent as serpents, and simple as doves.
(The Angels of the Third Heaven) appear simple in the external form... and like those who are not very wise... DLW 427:3.
(The Word despised) on account of its simple style.
(Many of the learned there confess) that the simple in faith had thought much more wisely (about the life after death) than they.
On the wise and simple in Heaven. Chapter.
Those who have loved truth and good little are those called simple... The simple (in Heaven) are in less light (than the wise)...

The simple of this kind are those whose interiors have been opened, but not so cultivated by spiritual, moral, civil, and natural truths. These perceive truths when they hear them, but do not see them in themselves.

The simple there are those who have acknowledged the Divine, loved the Word, and lived a spiritual moral life; but have not cultivated so much their interiors which are of the mind by means of knowledges.
Some Societies... teach the simple good from the Christian world, and lead them into the way to Heaven.
Those who have been in any truth from simple good are (there) imbued with Knowledges.
Some simple good Spirits have wanted to instruct the evil in truths and goods...
By appearances of what is good, etc. they would seduce the simple in heart and faith.
Believes that holy things serve only as a bond for the simple crowd.
(If the Lord did not preserve the equilibrium) falsities from evils would... affect the simple good who are in the ultimates of Heaven, who can be perverted more easily than the Angels.
A simple idea concerning each evil (is not correct).

Some of the simple common people... were brought into the state in which they had been here (and were examined as to their ideas about the future life, which are fully stated). The intelligent wondered that the simple had such a faith, while they had it not. (Thus) with every man who is in conjunction with Heaven there is an implanted [perception] about the life after death. Explained.
(Rareness of faith at this day, with both learned and simple.)

(The Papists there) allure to themselves simple good Spirits... and thus, through the simple good, conjoin themselves with Heaven... For the simple good, who are in the ultimates of Heaven, look no further than to a holy external... Hence is the greatest safeguard (the Papists) have.
Such (imaginary) Heavens were tolerated because they were conjoined with the simple good in the Ultimate Heaven and World of Spirits... (who) look especially to externals...
Therefore, Christians, who at the beginning were simple... distinguished the Divinity into three Persons, which was permitted on account of their simplicity.
The science of correspondences was not disclosed (then), because the Christians in the primitive Church were very simple...
The Word in the Heavens is so written that the simple understand it simply, and the wise wisely. Explained.

It appears as if... simple things must be less perfect than composite ones; yet the simples out of which composites are formed are more perfect; for prior or simpler things are more naked, and less covered over with substances... devoid of life; and are as it were more Divine, and are therefore nearer the spiritual Sun... All that is simple, the more simple it is, being more perfect, the more free it is from injury.
Inmostly in these (fibres, etc.) are the most simple things which are the most perfect...
These are successive compositions... from simples, which are their first substances.
It is held by some that there is a substance so simple that it is not a form from lesser forms... But such most simple substances have no existence. Explained. DP 6.
There are innumerable things in the most simple substance of all.
Simple Spirits fully understood the arcana of angelic wisdom; but only when they heard them. Explained.
The first production from earths, while they were... in their simplicity, was seeds.
The simple see more clearly what is good and true...
The simpler a thing is, the fuller it is.
Truths are multiple, but goods simple.
Man has no double speech (there), but a simple one: he speaks as he thinks.

Before His Human is acknowledged to be Divine, there is a marriage of the Lord with the Church; but only with those who approach the Lord and think of His Divine... So do the simple in faith and heart, and rarely the learned.
The sea = the external of Heaven and the Church, in which are the simple, who have thought naturally and very little spiritually about the things of the Church.
Only those who had been in simple faith from charity, or in some truth from good (could see the Angel).
Among the Angels there are simple and wise; and the wise have to judge, when the simple, from their simplicity and ignorance, are in doubt about what is just, or depart from it.
Extreme simplicity, so that there is no perception of what is good and true (a cause of lawful separation).

This (insect) appeared to them as a simple substance; but I said, There are innumerable things within it. It is so with every object which appears simple and least, whether in the actions, or the affections and thoughts... Everything divided is more and more multiple, and not more and more simple, because it approaches nearer and nearer to the infinite.
Simple adultery. Defined.
(Such) terminate their ideas in the atoms of Epicurus, the monads of Leibnitz, or the simple substances of Wolff, and thus close up their understanding...
(Stupefaction of some who were simple in faith and right at heart at the reasonings about imputation and predestination, and their indignant denunciation of them.)
Like the simple substance of Wolff...
(These) comparisons are for the sake of the simple, who see better from comparisons than deductions from the Word and reason.
Those whose external thinks, speaks, wills, and acts from the internal, are meant by the simple, in the Word. Illustrated.
A Spirit who appeared simple, because he acknowledged the Lord alone, was taken up into Heaven, and was as wise as the wiser Angels. Described.
God's sameness is not simple, but infinite.
If thine eye be simple, that is, good.
By giving to beggars, etc., children, servants, and, in general, all the simple, are initiated into charity.
Those who will well and think rationally, and thence act well and speak rationally, are meant in the Word by the simple in spirit. They are called simple because they are not double.
Some cannot examine themselves, as... the simple, who have no reflection.
The simple and the learned are regenerated differently.
If anyone is so simple that he can only think with the understanding what he sees with the eye, (let him think about the Holy Supper thus).
Calvin received into a Society where were the merely simple.
The simple speak very simply, but gratefully; for good simplicity is in itself grateful.
In one apparently simple idea... SE 3033:end.
They love their simplicity of homes.
If from simplicity and innocence...
There are still some who... can perceive whether [a thing] is good... but being of the lower orders... they think in simplicity... In the other life they are blessed. Described.
Supposes in simplicity...

On simplicity. - A certain simple Spirit was annoyed by other Spirits on account of his simplicity... There was such a simplicity in his speech and discourse that I knew he had been able to speak with the Lord... These, then, are the simple in heart, who are admitted to the Lord in preference to the learned.
Their phantasy was so simple.
One action which is supposed simple.
Whether there is simplicity in the general (idea of the word truth, an indication of character).
Still they become Angels, because they do it in simplicity and ignorance.
He supposes all things to be simple.
Their conjugial love was simple. I cannot describe the perception of it on account of its simplicity.
That with those who believe in simplicity and who do not admit objections, evil Spirits are dispersed. Explained.
They are kept in a state of sleep... These are simple, and some good.
A hypocrite persuaded the simple, who were otherwise good.
On those who have a simple idea of the Lord.
(How evil Spirits join simple upright ones to themselves, and make use of them to do harm.) SE 4561. SE 4573. SE 4574. SE 4579. SE 5883.
The perception of the [simple] about the life after death. SE 4629:9.
Simple Spirits in the First Heaven who correspond to the cuticles.
I spoke with those from the simple and rustic class, who had been in faith. Described.
Simple upright ones have often appeared above who were being carried downwards. Their place of temptation is there.
They reject those not deceitful, as the simple.
On the simple and unlearned there. SE 4694.
State of the simple who have not studied the truths of faith. They are vacillating. SE 4696. SE 4697.
There are also simple ones (in that city of faith alone) who believe simply.
(The idea of God in a human form) eradicated from the hearts of Christians, except of some simple ones.
Yet the simple, who were in good, apprehended.
But the simple know that their soul is again in a body (after death).
Very many preachers are such, and rarely others, except the simple or less learned.
By their persuasion they allure simple good Spirits...
Thereby (these wolves) are received by the simple good... Hence their dominion.
They had a sphere as if they were Christ, insomuch that the simple were completely led away... These could seduce more than the simple.
By such sports (the Babylonians) seduced the simple.
(These murderers) can infest the simple good.
These lay hidden... and the simple good.
Who instructed the simple from the Catholic nation.
They call the Spirits of that earth simple... yet they are a thousand times wiser.
Otherwise the simple, unless they think similarly about the soul.
The ideas of the simple were explored, and were found to be entirely in agreement with those of a Spirit about himself.
(Simple Spirits on the threshold of Heaven who are deceived by the Jesuits.)
See Last Judgment. SE 5697. SE 5739. SE 5814:end.
Hence the entirely simple cannot (be led to truths themselves in the Word).
The simple cannot thus place Things under the middle (view)... and therefore those of them believe who are not completely corporeal and worldly.
But the simple good who have not confirmed themselves have what is open interiorly...
On simple mercy.
That the simple understand things which the wise do not.
(The Moravians) then said openly... that the Lord was a very simple man...
Many (English) priests were convoked... the simple ones being removed...
Such a forest is removed from those in simple good... and therefore the simple have a much clearer perception...
These are simple external Spirits...
The simple were removed...
(With this devil) were associated upright Spirits, simple ones... He attracted the simple upright, who, being natural...
He came to a Society... where were the simple good...
He allured certain simple good Spirits... part of whom were in the interior sphere.
He penetrated even to the simple there, who helped him.
Thus induce simple Spirits to suppose that he is pious...
They are those in simple obedience.
By inspiring affections, they try to seduce the simple good.
They say they have Peter's keys... They are simple.
Most, especially the simple, think spiritually about these things... Almost all the simple, when approaching the Holy Supper, have thought nothing about the flesh and blood...
The eye simple = the understanding of truth. (Simple, here, means that which is one, and there is a one when there is truth from good. AE 313:end.) AE 526:13.
The simple good, who are in the ultimates of Heaven, receive influx from the higher Heavens. Signified.
How the simple in the Christian world think about the Lord.
That those will receive and acknowledge Him who are in simple truth and good. Signified.
The simple good in the Former Heaven. Explained.
The falsities of the simple in the Church who believe in the Lord and live well, are applied to good.

Most (of the Angels in the Ultimate Heaven) are simple, because they have not cultivated the understanding with interior truths, but only with exterior ones from the sense of the letter, according to which they have lived. Hence their spiritual mind, although it has not indeed been closed, has not been opened as with those who have received interior truths in doctrine and life. Hence as to spiritual things they have become simple, and are called upright.

But the wicked, who have lived exteriorly as Christians... although in internal form they were devils... are for the most part consociated with the upright, that is, with the simple good who are in the Ultimate Heaven; for exteriors consociate, and the simple good are such that they believe that to be good which in external form appears good. The separation of these. AE 669.
Divine truth in the sense of the letter... for the most simple who are sensuous.
Thereby seduce the simple.
This does not injure the simple in faith and heart.
The simple good are in truths, and therefore by conjunction with them there is power. The abuse of this.
Ideas of the simple as to what is meant by faith alone. See also AE 798:2, et seq.
Anything of (the idea of the Divine Human) remains solely with the simple; for the simple think of God as a Man. Ath 154:end.
From these (this heretical dogma) is derived to the simple; but these do not confirm it... and retain it only in the memory.
Why (the celestial Angels) appear simple.
The simple (in the Ultimate Heaven) believe that every man is the neighbour...
The simple who receive the faith signified by the beast acknowledge it as the truth of the Church.
Before a worldly man, the Word appears so simple... AE 1079:2.
These ideas of God are not so much those of the simple...
Concerning the simple substance, Leibnitz said...
They spurn those in the south and east (of London) as simple ones.
Those in the ultimates of Heaven... are in the shade of wisdom, and are simple.
Believe themselves wise, and all others simple.
Calvin was an upright man, but simple.
The simple say that every man is equally the neighbour... and that God looks to his character... but this is not to love the neighbour.

In the other life such simple ones are withdrawn and separated; for if they come among diabolical Spirits, they are allured to benefit them, and to do evil to the good... This is the greatest strength which the evil acquire...
